This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Cmd+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
#
# 示例数据
population_data <- data.frame(
  age_group = c("0-4", "0-4", "5-9", "5-9", "10-14", "10-14"),
  sex = c("Male", "Female", "Male", "Female", "Male", "Female"),
  total = c(1000, 950, 1200, 1150, 1100, 1050)
)
```


```{r}
# 创建合成人口的空数据框
synthetic_population <- data.frame(id = integer(0), age_group = character(0), sex = character(0))

# 为每个年龄段和性别生成个体
for (i in 1:nrow(population_data)) {
  age_group <- population_data$age_group[i]
  sex <- population_data$sex[i]
  total_count <- population_data$total[i]
  
  # 生成 total_count 个合成个体
  ids <- seq(1, total_count)
  sex_column <- rep(sex, total_count)
  age_column <- rep(age_group, total_count)
  
  # 将这些合成个体的数据合并到synthetic_population数据框中
  synthetic_population <- rbind(synthetic_population, data.frame(id = ids, age_group = age_column, sex = sex_column))
}

# 查看结果
head(synthetic_population)

write.csv(synthetic_population,"synthetic_population.csv")

```

When you save the notebook, an HTML file containing the code and output will be saved alongside it (click the *Preview* button or press *Cmd+Shift+K* to preview the HTML file). 

The preview shows you a rendered HTML copy of the contents of the editor. Consequently, unlike *Knit*, *Preview* does not run any R code chunks. Instead, the output of the chunk when it was last run in the editor is displayed.

```{r}
install.packages("synthpop")
library(synthpop)

# 创建一个简单的示例数据框
population <- data.frame(
  age_group = c("0-4", "5-9", "10-14", "15-19"),
  sex = c("Male", "Female", "Male", "Female"),
  total = c(1000, 950, 1200, 1150)
)

# 使用synthpop包生成合成数据
synthetic_data <- syn(population)

# 查看合成数据
synthetic_data$syn

```
